name: Musée du Barreau de Paris
description: museum dedicated to the Paris bar and its lawyers

summary.text: The Musée du Barreau de Paris is a French museum dedicated to the history of the Paris Bar and its lawyers. It is located close to the Église Saint-Eustache, in the 1st arrondissement of Paris, at 25 rue du Jour, Paris, and opens for groups, on appointment.
